gloss: bending and stretching; flexion and extension

definitions.gloss: bending and stretching; flexion and extension
definitions.explanation: the action of repeatedly bending and straightening a joint or the body, typically as exercise or warm-up

examples.japanese: {屈伸|くっしん}{運動|うんどう}をする。
{膝|ひざ}の{屈伸|くっしん}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}して{準備|じゅんび}した。
examples.english: I warmed up by repeatedly bending and stretching my knees.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}の{前|まえ}に{屈伸|くっしん}をして{体|からだ}をほぐしましょう。
examples.english: Let's loosen up with some bending and stretching before exercising.

notes:
Refers specifically to the motion of bending and extending joints, most commonly the knees. A standard part of warm-up routines in Japanese physical education and sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屈伸|くっしん}{運動|うんどう}: bending and stretching exercise
- {膝|ひざ}の{屈伸|くっしん}: knee bends
- {屈伸|くっしん}する: to bend and stretch
- {屈伸|くっしん}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す: to repeat bending and stretching

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {屈|くつ} (to bend) and {伸|しん} (to extend), describing the two opposite movements as a pair.

RELATED WORDS:
- {準備運動|じゅんびうんどう}: warm-up exercise
- {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}: flexibility exercises, stretching
- ストレッチ: stretch (loanword)
